'''Xbrr-Zinngogg''' was a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] from [[Rhommamool/Legends|Rhommamool]] who later served as a loyal individual to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|As you know, a band of agitators – controlled by Nom Anor – continues to spread unrest in our system. We have repeatedly requested the Republic's intervention, only to be ignored.|Xbrr-Zinngogg to the New Republic Ruling Council|<ref name="CE3" />}}
In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], Xbrr-Zinngogg went to the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in order to warn the [[New Republic Ruling Council]] about [[Nom Anor]]'s ongoing attempts of [[Red Knights of Life|destabilization]] in the [[Osarian system]] and requested that the Republic intervention. However, [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] refused to intervene, considering the situation as a internal matter.<ref name="CE3" />

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 1|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 1]], "Rhommamool" was misspelled as "Rhommammoo".<ref name="CE3" />
